verdict.rationale: An IP office could plausibly publish a developer API with interactive documentation, so this axis applies. The evidence covers only web guidance pages, online and paper filing, and human-facing search tools. Nothing describes an API reference, runnable examples, or any developer portal, and the probe shows the trade-mark search host walls automated agents at robots.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
